name: shutdown.
source:
Play as a Doll on the operating table. You have mere minutes before you're disassembled and dead... But who is that, picking away at your rivets.?

[From [url=https://kale-chips.itch.io/shutdown]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在手术台上扮演洋娃娃。你只有几分钟的时间，然后你就会被分解并死亡……但是那个人是谁，正在摘你的铆钉。？

[来自[url=https://kale-chips.itch.io/shutdown]itch.io[/url]]
